verdict.rationale: cubic documents an analytics dashboard with an AI review tab showing what its reviews find and what the team fixes, which covers findings and a fix-based acceptance signal. It also has a delivery tab, and an Analytics API provides PR-level counts of issues flagged and fixed. missing for 10: explicit review-coverage metrics (e.g., share of PRs reviewed), explicit org-wide roll-up across repos, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboards.
